title.narrative: European Human Rights Advocacy Centre/Eastern Europe

description.narrative: 1. Through expert legal support, lawyers and human rights defenders have increased skills, capacity and resilience to challenge human rights abuses. 2. Through trauma-informed litigation, applicants voices are heard and barriers to justice challenged, leading to increased access to justice for vulnerable and persecuted communities. 3. Through litigation, national and international precedents are set, leading to increased national protection and raised international human rights standards across the region.

Med denna insats, "Fighting for human rights in times of war and repression, 2024-2027, ska European Human Rights Advocacy Centre (EHRAC) arbeta med människorättsförsvarare i Ukraina, Georgien, Azerbajdzjan och Armenien. Bidraget kommer att stärka demokrati, mänskliga rättigheter och jämställdhet i regionen. EHRAC fokuserar strategiska internationella MR-instrument och mekanismer för att genom rättstvister stärka mänskliga rättigheter och rättsstatsprincipen i samarbete med lokala civilsamhällesorganisationer.

With this project, "Fighting for human rights in times of war and repression", 2024-2027 submitted initially to Sida 2023-11-30, European Human Rights Advocacy Centre (EHRAC) proposes to work with human rights defenders (HRDs) across Ukraine, Georgia, Azerbaijan and Armenia, take on strategic legal challenges and aims hold governments to account through the use of international humanitarian and human rights law and connected mechanisms. The contribution will enhance democracy and gender equality at a pivotal time for the region.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
